🇲🇽⚖️ <u>CNDH DOCUMENTS STATE TERROR IN MEXICO'S DIRTY WAR</u>

Mexico's National Human Rights Commission presented recommendations 46/2022 and 98VG/2023 documenting how military-police networks repressed left-wing dissidents between 1951 and 1990. CNDH president Rosario Piedra Ibarra said the victims of that state political violence are still unquantifiable today. Truth first, then justice — the archive is finally being opened.
banner: DIRTY WAR: CNDH CONFIRMS STATE TERROR

🇲🇽🧮 <u>MEXICAN MATHEMATICIAN CLOSES IN ON RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS</u>

José Damián Espinosa developed a new approach to the Riemann hypothesis — one of the six Millennium Problems still unsolved — with an equivalent reformulation published as a preprint on Zenodo, La Jornada reports. The work advances the prime number theorem. The hypothesis has stood unsolved since 1859; a Mexican mind is now knocking on its door.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>ARMY CAPTURES FOUR CJNG BOSSES IN MICHOACÁN</u>

Mexican Army personnel captured four CJNG cell leaders in Zamora, Michoacán, in direct actions against groups dedicated to drug production and trafficking, La Jornada reports. Federal forces reinforced operations to clear highway blockades across the state — Mexico doing the work on its own soil, with its own forces.

‍US MEDIA SILENCE: Sheinbaum reports 101 million public health consultations, 32 new hospitals August 18, 2026 | 🟢 📰 Zero US coverage: 101 million public consultations; general consults up 50% and specialty care up 90% across the 24 IMSS-Bienestar states; 32 new hospitals. 🇲🇽 If the system were collapsing, it would be front-page news. Specialty consultations have risen 90% since 2023 — the direction of the curve never makes the papers. • "Instead of going to the private sector, people are turning to the public healthcare system" • "These are very clear indicators that people's access to healthcare is improving"

‍MARKETPLACE: Mexico launches its own electric car to show it can do more than build for other countries August 19, 2026 | 🟢 📰 Marketplace covers Olinia straight: Mexico's own mini-EV, under $9,000, charges from a household outlet, built for Mexican streets. 🇲🇽 Even VW Mexico's former chief admits not even the Chinese brands offer anything like it. The obligatory China caveat appears — though that tech is exactly what keeps the car at $9,000. • "It can generate knowledge, develop technology, and design solutions" • "not even the Chinese... are trying to offer these kinds of cars"

‍BLOOMBERG: Mexico Weighs Tougher Trade Rules for China as US Talks Grind On August 18, 2026 | 🟡 📰 Bloomberg: four unnamed officials say Mexico may tariff Chinese steel and autos — framed as "alignment with Washington." The Economy Ministry's denial makes paragraph four. 🔍 Existing tariffs already cut covered Chinese imports by a third; light vehicles down 40%+. The same dispatch concedes no concrete proposal exists — the headline says otherwise. • "anti-dumping measures would deepen Mexico's alignment with Washington" • "There is currently no concrete plan or proposal"
banner: Mexico eyes China tariffs under US pressure

text: ‍UNHERD: Will Trump target Mexico next? August 18, 2026 | 🟡 📰 UnHerd asks if Mexico is the next forever war — and brings receipts: of InSight Crime's ten most notorious narco-linked officials, 6 are PRI, 2 PAN, 2 Morena. Washington indicts only Morena. 💀 All 269 Mexican extradition requests denied since 2018. Even a piece this sharp can't resist calling Sinaloa and Tamaulipas "failed states." • "selectively and exclusively targeted Morena politicians" • "the groundwork is being laid"

text: ‍CBS NEWS: U.S. quietly deporting Mexican migrants to Guatemala and Honduras, angering Mexico August 18, 2026 | 🟢 📰 CBS: The US is quietly deporting Mexicans to Guatemala and Honduras — flying them around their own country, which accepts all its nationals back. Hundreds already sent. Unannounced. Unprecedented. "This is almost entirely punitive." Mexico's Foreign Ministry says no third-country agreement exists and it will receive all its nationals — CBS quoted it in full, a rarity. • "This is almost entirely punitive" — WOLA's Adam Isacson • "to broadcast the hardship... to encourage people to self-deport"

🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO WEIGHS NEW ANTIDUMPING TARIFFS ON CHINA AS T-MEC REVIEW ADVANCES</u>

El Financiero reports that the Economy and Finance ministries are evaluating new trade restrictions and higher duties on selected Chinese goods — steel and vehicles top the list — building on January's package of up to 50% tariffs on some 1,500 product categories from countries without a trade deal with Mexico.

The frame is Plan México: protect national manufacturing while negotiating a multi-year T-MEC extension. Economy confirms case-by-case dumping investigations are underway.

Beijing pays for the broken dishes — not Mexican industry.
banner: T-MEC: MEXICO EYES MORE CHINA TARIFFS

text:
🇲🇽🏥 <u>MEXICO'S PUBLIC HEALTH SYSTEM HITS RECORD 101 MILLION CONSULTATIONS</u>

101.2 million consultations — up 28% since 2023. Surgeries up 30%, to 1.9 million. Thirty-two new hospitals opened under Sheinbaum, and 80 ISSSTE operating rooms that sat mothballed are back in service, said Martí Batres: "hemos abierto 80 quirófanos."

In the 24 states federalized under IMSS-Bienestar, specialty consultations grew 90%.

Sheinbaum: "En vez de irse al privado, se están yendo al sistema público."
